label: Cartesian causal adequacy compared with q.4 a.2 preexistence and the cause-of-perfection premises
summary: Analyst formulations over the shared GradesFrame, attribution deferred (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III; no source records). Verdicts. (1) Respect-wise containment in every cause (634a80b8: whatever causes x's being r, with x in act in r, is in act in r; uniform IN_ACT_4 reading, one InAct with the mode left open on both sides) is an ALLY and hinge of q.4 a.2 preexistence (PEPC, 64498e7e): with the cause-of-being transfer f8ba2429 it gives PEPC (result 77485e04), and it follows from the strict Aristotelian comparative d5a94eb1, more-such-has-the-perfection c11369aa and excluded middle (result 877bcd00). Together these factor the existing four-premise derivation PERFECTION-PREEXISTENCE-FROM-CAUSAL-TRANSFER through one hinge. The 2026-11-20 discover diagnosis (attempt 9869069b) had reported 'CausesIn c x r gives InAct c r' as the missing bridge for PEPC; 634a80b8 is a weakening of that bridge (it adds the antecedent InAct x r), stated over one frame. Its esse instance is 'nothing gives being that it does not have' (4a5a43a5), registered as a strength order (result 73532b47). Its CAUSE_1 analogue for actualizing is ActualizerIsInAct (40fc38ad). It is an analyst strengthening of the Cartesian clause, not attributed. (2) The total-cause reading on the respect-wise scope (90c0d77f, efficient and total cause, definition 33ebf451) is a STRENGTH-ORDERED VARIANT: 634a80b8 strengthens it (result cd313585, relation 93dd9b29; strictness not registered). (3) Under the respect-wise reading, total-cause containment and PEPC are DISTINCT STATEMENTS, neither entailing the other (two finite grades frames, result b704a38d): PEPC is about every perfection of an effect whose being a cause, possibly partial, causes; total-cause containment is about the perfection a total cause causes. The gap from the Cartesian clause to PEPC is closed by the transfer f8ba2429 plus containment for partial causes. The whole-effect sibling (4643a655, CONTAINMENT_SCOPE_2 of disambiguation 26b6a64e; the stone example) is instead entailed by PEPC (registered strength order, result 8900a666). (4) The transfer statements f8ba2429, b26c10a0 and the CausalPerfectionTransfer reconstruction are ALLIES of a different kind: they say which perfections a cause of being causes, not what a cause has; they compose with containment (through the existing reconstruction b26c10a0 with the residual 5a4afaa5 gives f8ba2429) and are not rivals or strength variants of it. (5) 'At least as much reality' is a comparative. On MORE_2's degree side (represented degree in a preorder, DEF-PER-RESPECT-DEGREE-FAMILY), the strict comparative d5a94eb1 with the open calibration MoreInExceedsDegree (98755509) and excluded middle gives the non-strict deg r x ≤ deg r c for total causes (87f41688, result 69ead222). On bare MORE_1 it does not: a two-being control where MoreIn holds both ways satisfies the strict comparative and more-such-has while 'no effect is more r than its total cause' fails (result bc769e84). So the strict comparative yields, with the calibration, the weaker Cartesian non-strict comparative (the proof never uses Total, so for every cause), and not without a further premise such as the calibration or asymmetry (with irreflexivity) of MoreIn. Per respect, 87f41688 is an analyst generalization of Descartes's single overall degree of reality. Rivals: the recorded strong-emergence rival 3143560d targets PEPC; with f8ba2429 it equally targets containment in every cause (by result 77485e04). No further substantive objection identified to the containment hinge itself; the Cartesian-circle objection has no target here (no clear-and-distinct-perception premise). Nothing is established; every new statement is open. Mode of act: every containment statement here uses one InAct (IN_ACT_4) on both sides, a uniform reading. The Cartesian clause is mode-asymmetric (formal in the effect, formal or eminent in the cause); no uniform determination IN_ACT_1, IN_ACT_2 or IN_ACT_3 equals that mixed reading, so it is a distinct, unformalized sibling needing a sense bridge (next step: state it over TermSenseForks.ActFrame with InActFormally in the effect and InActFormallyOrVirtually in the cause, with an explicit sense_bridges premise). The hinge's warrant depends on the mode: read formally on both sides it faces trigger-cause cases (a spark that is not explosive causes an explosion's being explosive), read virtually it is near-trivial (a cause of r has the power to produce r). Operative-content follow-up (docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, “What can the complete performance of a product tell us about its producer?”): two makers yield the same entire released-governor correction table while their own local correction laws differ. Two zero-axiom local Lean checks establish the source test and impossibility of distinguishing it from that table. This tests one independently specified organization, not the absence of all higher analogues. A positive case for eminent possession must warrant both preservation of the content in the source and superiority of its mode. No new record or premise discharge.
